career_overview.short_description: Understand and design basic electronic and digital circuits. Learn to calculate, simulate and document safe low-voltage designs.
responsibilities: Assess goals and constraints relevant to hardware engineer work
Apply appropriate tools and methods to a bounded task
representative_work: A documented and simulated introductory circuit or digital subsystem.

roadmap.title: Hardware Engineer: beginner foundations and starter project
roadmap.intended_learner: Motivated beginner; basic computer literacy assumed, with no prior professional experience.
roadmap.starting_requirements: Computer, internet access, text editor and browser. Most tasks use free software or simulation; specialist equipment, accounts and costs are flagged for review when applicable.
roadmap.final_outcome: A documented and simulated introductory circuit or digital subsystem.
